notes.note: Fixed a crash on startup that could occur on some devices ([Bug 2056166](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2056166)).
Fixed audio playing silently on some music and audio streaming sites after pausing and resuming playback ([Bug 2053586](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2053586)).
Fixed a crash that could occur when loading certain frames within a page ([Bug 2054485](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2054485)).
